svg.title: API-independent local implementation and explicit activation gates
svg.desc: Local UI and pre-provisioned stdio agent use current scoped SQLite state. Drafts need separate human approval. Optional file root and recipe observe exact bytes, not tests or deployment. Paid inference and native capture remain unconfigured.
